verses.pali: Āmisagaru parisā no saddhammagaru, saddhammagaru parisā no āmisagaru.
verses.english: An assembly that values things of the flesh, not the true teaching, and an assembly that values the true teaching, not things of the flesh.

verses.pali: Katamā ca, bhikkhave, āmisagaru parisā no saddhammagaru?
verses.english: And what is an assembly that values things of the flesh, not the true teaching?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, yassaṁ parisāyaṁ bhikkhū gihīnaṁ odātavasanānaṁ sammukhā aññamaññassa vaṇṇaṁ bhāsanti:
verses.english: It is an assembly where the mendicants praise each other in front of the white-clothed laypeople, saying:

verses.pali: ‘asuko bhikkhu ubhatobhāgavimutto, asuko paññāvimutto, asuko kāyasakkhī, asuko diṭṭhippatto, asuko saddhāvimutto, asuko dhammānusārī, asuko saddhānusārī, asuko sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, asuko dussīlo pāpadhammo’ti.
verses.english: ‘The mendicant so-and-so is freed both ways; so-and-so is freed by wisdom; so-and-so is a direct witness; so-and-so is attained to view; so-and-so is freed by faith; so-and-so is a follower of teachings; so-and-so is a follower by faith; so-and-so is ethical, of good character; so-and-so is unethical, of bad character.’

verses.pali: Te taṁ lābhaṁ labhitvā gathitā mucchitā ajjhopannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.
verses.english: And when they get these things, they use them tied, infatuated, attached, blind to the drawbacks, and not understanding the escape.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, āmisagaru parisā no saddhammagaru.
verses.english: This is called an assembly that values things of the flesh, not the true teaching.

verses.pali: Katamā ca, bhikkhave, saddhammagaru parisā noāmisagaru?
verses.english: And what is an assembly that values the true teaching, not things of the flesh?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, yassaṁ parisāyaṁ bhikkhū gihīnaṁ odātavasanānaṁ sammukhā aññamaññassa vaṇṇaṁ na bhāsanti:
verses.english: It is an assembly where the mendicants don’t praise each other in front of the white-clothed laypeople, saying:

verses.pali: ‘asuko bhikkhu ubhatobhāgavimutto, asuko paññāvimutto, asuko kāyasakkhī, asuko diṭṭhippatto, asuko saddhāvimutto, asuko dhammānusārī, asuko saddhānusārī, asuko sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, asuko dussīlo pāpadhammo’ti.
verses.english: ‘The mendicant so-and-so is freed both ways; so-and-so is freed by wisdom; so-and-so is a direct witness; so-and-so is attained to view; so-and-so is freed by faith; so-and-so is a follower of teachings; so-and-so is a follower by faith; so-and-so is ethical, of good character; so-and-so is unethical, of bad character.’

verses.pali: Te taṁ lābhaṁ labhitvā agathitā amucchitā anajjhosannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.
verses.english: And when they get these things, they use them untied, uninfatuated, unattached, seeing the drawbacks, and understanding the escape.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, saddhammagaru parisā noāmisagaru.
verses.english: This is called an assembly that values the true teaching, not things of the flesh.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imāsaṁ dvinnaṁ parisānaṁ yadidaṁ saddhammagaru parisā noāmisagarū”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two assemblies is the assembly that values the true teaching, not things of the flesh.”
